map.交强险限额内不分责任比例（有责：医疗 1.8 万 / 死亡伤残 18 万 / 财: Within compulsory traffic insurance limits there is no liability apportionment (liable limits: 18,000 medical / 180,000 death or disability / 2,000 property; no-fault limits apply when not liable); only the excess is borne by commercial insurance or the tortfeasor at the liability share. Disability compensation = disposable, or per-capita net, income × years × disability coefficient; lost earnings = monthly income ÷ 30 × days off
map.先由交强险在分项限额内全额赔付且不按责任比例打折（有责限额：医疗费用 1.8 万: Compulsory insurance pays in full within its sub-limits without discounting by liability share (liable limits: 18,000 for medical costs, 180,000 for death or disability, 2,000 for property; no-fault limits apply when not liable), and only the loss above each sub-limit is multiplied by the liability share and borne by commercial third-party insurance or the tortfeasor. Disability compensation uses the per-capita disposable income of urban residents in the locality of the court for the previous year, with the disability coefficient and the number of years, which is 20 under 60, one less for each year of age from 60 to 74, and 5 at 75 or over; medical expenses, lost earnings as monthly income ÷ 30 × days off, hospital meal allowances and dependants' living costs are first allocated to the corresponding sub-limit and then paid under the rules above.
map.受诉法院所在地上一年度城镇居民人均可支配收入 × 赔偿年限 × 伤残系数: Per-capita disposable income of urban residents in the locality of the court for the previous year × years × disability coefficient
map.60岁以下20年；60岁以上每增一岁减一年；75岁以上按5年: 20 years under 60, one year less for each year of age above 60, and 5 years at 75 or over
map.受诉法院所在地上一年度职工月平均工资 × 6个月: Average monthly wage of employees in the locality of the court for the previous year × 6 months
map.一级100%，二级90%...十级10%，死亡同100%: Grade 1 is 100%, grade 2 is 90%, down to grade 10 at 10%, with death also at 100%
map.交通事故后，按伤残等级、医疗费等估算残疾/死亡赔偿金与总赔偿。: After an accident, estimate the disability or death compensation and the total award from the disability grade, medical expenses and so on.
map.交强险限额内不分责任，超出部分按责任比例承担。: Within the compulsory traffic insurance limits there is no apportionment, and the excess is borne by liability share.
map.结合被扶养人生活费、精神抚慰金等综合测算。: Dependants' living costs and solatium are included in the overall estimate.
map.城镇十级伤残、全责: Urban resident, grade 10 disability, full liability
map.残疾赔偿金 = 5.2万 × 20 × 0.1 = 104,000 元；医疗费: Disability compensation = 52,000 × 20 × 0.1 = ¥104,000; medical expenses ¥30,000; within the compulsory insurance limits of ¥18,000 for medical costs and ¥180,000 for death or disability there is no apportionment, and the excess is borne at 100%, giving about ¥134,000 plus other items.
map.上述超出交强险部分按 70% 承担，总赔偿相应降低；工具按责任比例输出对方应赔金: The part above the compulsory insurance limits is borne at 70%, so the total falls accordingly; the tool shows the amount payable by the other party at that share.
map.交强险和三者险怎么赔？: How do compulsory and third-party insurance pay out?
map.先由交强险在限额内赔付（不分责），不足部分由商业三者险按责任比例赔，仍不足由侵权: Compulsory insurance pays first within its limits with no apportionment; the shortfall is met by commercial third-party insurance at the liability share, and anything still outstanding by the tortfeasor.
